blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Police arrested two suspects and seized 69,634 liters of petroleum products worth P9 million in two separate operations against illegal fuel trading in Lipa City on Nov. 18, the Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) said on Thursday. The CIDG Batangas Provincial Field Unit conducted the operations at two gasoline stations in Barangays San Sebastian and Sabang after finding that both establishments were operating without the required certificates and licenses from the Department of Energy (DOE).
